_comment: Codex official passthrough kill-switch. When enabled, Codex clients hitting /v1/responses and /v1/alpha/search with bare gpt-* models are reverse-proxied to chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/* using ~/.codex/auth.json. Non-gpt models (cx/*, minimax-cn/*, …) and non-Codex harnesses always use normal 9router routing.
